verifications.claim: The Fab Five refers to the 1991 University of Michigan men's basketball recruiting class consisting of Chris Webber, Jalen Rose, Juwan Howard, Jimmy King, and Ray Jackson.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Fab Five was the 1991 University of Michigan men's basketball team recruiting class... consisted of... Chris Webber (#4) and Jalen Rose (#5)... Juwan Howard (#25)... Jimmy King (#24) and... Ray Jackson (#21).' R2/R3/R7: lists the same five members.
verifications.reasoning: Directly matches the exact description, names, and year in primary source.

verifications.claim: The Fab Five was the first NCAA team to start five freshmen in a championship game in 1992 and 1993.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Fab Five were the first team in NCAA history to compete in the championship game with all-freshman starters.' (refers to 1992 as freshmen; 1993 as sophomores: 'reached the 1992 and 1993... as both freshmen and sophomores.').
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm first all-freshman starters in 1992 championship, but in 1993 they were sophomores, directly contradicting claim of five freshmen both years.
